name: DermiVe Moisturizing Wash Face & Body 100ml | Jenpharm
description:
DermiVe Moisturizing Wash by Jenpharm is a gentle, sulphate-free cleanser for face and body that effectively removes dirt and impurities without stripping the skin’s natural moisture. Formulated with Hyaluronic Acid and 3 Essential Ceramides (NP, AP, EOP), it hydrates, repairs, and strengthens the skin barrier while keeping it soft and supple.
Perfect for dry, eczema-prone, or sensitive skin, this non-irritant, fragrance-free formula is safe even for babies. Use daily to experience healthy, calm, and nourished skin.How to Use:
 Use as part of your morning and nighttime skincare routine.
 Take a dime-sized amount and massage gently on dry skin for 1 minute.
 Rinse off with lukewarm or cool water.
 Follow with DermiVe Moisturizer to lock in hydration.
 Apply SPF 40+ sunscreen during the day for protection.Suitable For:
 Normal, Dry & Sensitive SkinWhen to Apply:
 AM and PMSafety Information:
 Perform a patch test before first use.
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse thoroughly if contact occurs.
 For external use only.
 Keep out of reach of children.

Package Includes:
 1 x DermiVe Moisturizing Wash Face & Body (100ml)
